cassette: none: reducer.PostgresSupplyChainImpactWriter operates over []SupplyChainImpactFinding Go values, not a CanonicalMaterialization; the two fixture findings live inline in go/internal/replay/costcounting/supply_chain_impact_cost_test.go
description: Two affected_exact impact findings for distinct CVEs in one scope, driven through the production Postgres fact writer over an InstrumentedDB-wrapped counting queryer. #6831 made WriteSupplyChainImpactFindings transactional with replace-set semantics: a per-(scope, generation) pg_advisory_xact_lock, the shared reducerBatchInsertVersionedFacts bounded chunked bulk insert (batch size 1000, issue #5317), and one retraction UPDATE that tombstones the (scope, generation)'s prior findings the pass no longer derives. #7142 added the fencing-token admission compare-and-set right after the lock. One Write call therefore costs exactly 4 statements (raised from 3 on 2026-10-01, measured 4 observations; the lock, the admission and the retraction are O(1) per pass, only the insert scales, in ceil(N/1000) chunks). The companion N+1 negative control (one Write call per finding) records 8 observations and still exceeds this budget.
